definitions.explanation: an onomatopoeic expression representing open, hearty laughter; often used in text to express amusement

examples.japanese: あはは、⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧！
あはは⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
「あはは、⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧でしょ？」

notes:
LAUGHTER ONOMATOPOEIA:
Japanese has many words to express different types of laughter:

OPEN/HEARTY:
- あはは - ha ha ha (open laugh)
- わはは - hearty laugh (often masculine)
- がはは - loud, boisterous laugh

QUIET/RESTRAINED:
- ⟦うふふ→うふふ：08806_ufufu⟧ - quiet, often feminine giggle
- ⟦くすくす→くすくす：05771_kusukusu⟧ - suppressed giggle
- ふふふ - soft chuckle

EMBARRASSED/NERVOUS:
- ⟦えへへ→えへへ：08807_ehehe⟧ - sheepish laugh
- あはは (with awkwardness) - nervous laugh
- へへへ - slightly mischievous

NEGATIVE:
- ⟦にやにや→にやにや：05766_niyaniya⟧ - smirk
- ⟦げらげら→げらげら：05768_geragera⟧ - laughing loudly (can be rude)
